request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access
Hardening, security audits, and formal verification
Hardened economic model and SPO/dApp partner pipeline
Public rollout and 24 months of operations deferred to Phase 2 in Q1 2027
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 funding to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness, including hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, stewardship, and economic foundations for launch.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's existing SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as native fBTC.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA, including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month Phase 1 delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access.
Bifrost custody of locked BTC is proposed to be distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, with movement of funds requiring a threshold representing the majority of delegated stake.
If SPO coordination fails, Bifrost will use a federated mode as an operational fallback.
Bifrost smart contracts, off-chain tooling, and SDK are released under Apache 2.0 and can be audited, forked, run, or built on without permission.
Bifrost has Catalyst Fund 14 funding of ₳739,000 for architecture, testnet MVP, and documentation, with milestone M1 and M2 marked done and approved in the document.
The proposer targets 1,200 BTC TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029 as Bifrost contributions to Cardano 2030 KPIs.
The proposal states that bridge fee surplus will return to the Cardano Treasury in fBTC and split with SPOs under its sustainability model.
The document states that public launch and 24 months of operations are intentionally separated into a Phase 2 proposal in Q1 2027 after the bridge has been proven on-chain.

summary: The document presents a large Phase 1 treasury request for a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge moving from testnet toward controlled mainnet readiness, with substantial technical ambition and public-infrastructure framing but many key delivery, security, adoption, and revenue claims remaining proposer assertions within the supplied text.
